verdict.rationale: Fellow issues named API keys that act as the authenticated user (fellow-docs-16, fellow-docs-2, fellow-docs-35), so an agent's credential is limited to that user's data. Super Admin keys are a separate, broader tier (fellow-docs-7, fellow-docs-14). For agents using the MCP server, admins can restrict which MCP tools assistants may use, access is limited to the user's existing data, and connections can be revoked and audited by last-used timestamp (fellow-docs-10, fellow-docs-49, fellow-docs-50). The action-item 'scope' parameter is only a query filter, not a credential scope (fellow-docs-45). Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes such as read-only or per-resource access on REST API keys, per-key expiry and rotation controls, and independent corroboration.
